firstPlayerRule: The Pilot, using the blue dice, places the first die in the opening round. The players then alternate placing one die at a time.
clarifications: The arrow in the Current Altitude screen determines who starts each round.
Setup assigns the Pilot to the blue side of the control panel and the Co-Pilot to the orange side.
Strategy discussion and hidden dice rolls happen before dice placement.
